title: Two servers on one database, each with its own Hosted Harness
subtitle: Sessions run on server A (Harness HA); their closes are admitted on server B; MySQL 8.4.11, JVM on UTC

columns.head: Both servers healthy
lines: ## 8 closes admitted on B back to back
== B first (HB never held it: live writer -> retry), then A
## 8 closes admitted on B, 9 s apart
## A and HA killed (-9), close admitted on B
== waits for HA's writer lease (60 s, database time)

columns.head: Retries already at the 60 s backoff
lines: ## A cannot reach HA for 180 s, then can (3 closes)
!! done 7.3 s / 27.4 s / 168.3 s after A reaches HA
== slowest: attempts BAAAAAAABBA - B won 2 rounds after
== the heal. Likely cause: retries carry no jitter, so the
== same server tends to scan first round after round
## A's Java dies, HA lives on (shared Store URL)
!! close via B not completed after 150 s (8 attempts)
!! A's Java back: next 150 s, 2 more attempts, both by B

note: Within the PR's documented risk ('only the server whose Harness holds the Session can seal it ... several backoff intervals of up to a minute each'). Measured: seconds when healthy; minutes once retries sit at the 60 s cap, because the non-holding server can keep winning the claim.

title: Documented limit: a short Store outage that overlaps one close attempt
subtitle: Harness -> Store journal commits answer 503 for 5 s (renewals pass); JVM on UTC; MySQL 8.4.11 shown, MariaDB 10.11.18 alike

columns.head: Control: outage while the Session is idle
lines: Store commits 503 for 5 s, nobody closes

columns.head: Outage overlaps the first close attempt
lines: -- +15 s   op running  Harness DELETE: 503 x5
-- +60 s   op running  503 x6   writer ACTIVE (renewed every 30 s)
-- +121 s  op running  503 x7   Session closing, input refused
-- +182 s  op running  503 x8   0 journal commits since outage
## restart the Hosted Harness, then Java
!! completes 58-59 s later (old writer lease), java_durable

note: The PR documents this (Risk & Scope: 'A Harness that stopped writing the Session's journal cannot close it'). Measured trigger is broader than a failed Turn commit: any Store blip that overlaps a close attempt. No operator signal exists yet (no recovery_blocked); the fix belongs in the Harness.

title: Are the two guards the bot asked about load-bearing?
subtitle: Single-site mutants of a32bd797; real stack (two servers) and the PR's own suites (19 tests in the 4 lifecycle classes)

columns.head: Real stack, two servers (S4 a+b)
lines: ++ via B: harness_confirmed after HA seals the writer
## M1: drop the hasLiveWriter gate in settle()
-- via B: java_durable in 0.3 s, HA writer still ACTIVE
-- A+HA dead: completes in 0.3 s under a live lease

note: Both guards named in the bot review turn the suites red when removed, and M1/M2 are also caught end to end. Across servers the lease-owner check already refuses a stale worker (paused-worker run); the generation check covers a same-owner re-claim, which the store test pins.
